about.title: About AFRICA NEX
about.missionText: AFRICA NEX is a B2B platform connecting Algerian producers to international markets, starting with Africa. We believe trade is a driver of development for the entire continent.
about.visionText: To become the leading B2B marketplace for trade between Algeria, Africa and the world.
about.teamDesc: A team passionate about international trade and technological innovation.

services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Complete solutions to grow your business internationally
services.b2bDesc: AFRICA NEX qualifies every request and connects you with buyers and producers in 8+ African countries.
services.marketingDesc: Our AI agents manage your online presence, campaigns and visibility in target markets.
services.logisticsDesc: Maritime, road and air freight. We simplify exports to Africa and worldwide.
services.consultingDesc: Regulatory, customs and commercial support to succeed in your first exports.
services.insuranceDesc: Your goods and receivables are covered by CAGEX: export credit insurance, buyer verification and cargo transport guarantee.
services.complianceDesc: Product classification under the Harmonized System (HS), customs documentation and regulatory compliance for friction-free clearance.

onboarding.title: Initial setup
onboarding.intro: Three steps to present your company to African buyers. You can stop at any time and come back later.
onboarding.identityIntro: Your company's official details, as registered in the trade register.
onboarding.address: Head office or production site address
onboarding.privacyNote: Your tax ID, trade register number, address and phone numbers stay private: neither the public nor buyers can see them. AFRICA NEX uses them to verify your company and contact you.
onboarding.errorCompanyName: Enter the company name (at least 2 characters).
onboarding.errorNif: The tax ID must have exactly 15 digits.
onboarding.errorNifTaken: This tax ID is already registered on the platform. Contact AFRICA NEX if it is yours.
onboarding.errorPhone: Incomplete or invalid number for this country.
onboarding.errorGeneric: Saving failed. Please try again in a moment.
onboarding.comingSoon: This step is coming very soon. Your legal identity has been saved.
onboarding.sideDraft: Your profile stays in draft, hidden from the public, until you publish it.
onboarding.sidePrivate: Buyers never see your contact details: every request goes through AFRICA NEX.
onboarding.sideHelp: A question? Write to us at sarlafricanex@gmail.com.
onboarding.presentationIntro: What buyers will read on your profile: your business, flagship products, capacities and export references.
onboarding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 2 MB maximum. Light background recommended.
onboarding.translationNote: English- and Arabic-speaking buyers will read the version in their language. Without a translation, the French version is shown.
onboarding.errorDescription: Describe your company in at least 80 characters.
onboarding.errorLogoType: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
onboarding.productIntro: Your flagship product: this is how buyers will find you and ask you for a quote.
onboarding.productNamePlaceholder: Extra virgin olive oil, 5 L can
onboarding.hsCodeHelp: The code appears on your export declarations. If in doubt, AFRICA NEX helps you check it.
onboarding.photoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 4 MB maximum.
onboarding.productNote: You can then add more products and complete logistics details (packaging, 20 and 40 ft container capacity, stock) in your catalogue.
onboarding.errorHsCode: The HS code has 6, 8 or 10 digits.
onboarding.errorPrice: Enter a price above zero (2 decimals maximum).
onboarding.errorPhotoType: The photo must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
onboarding.sidePublished: Your profile is visible to buyers in the directory.
